agent_responses.response_str:
Thanks for reaching out! Unfortunately, I'm a **coding assistant** — my tools are designed for reading files, editing code, running commands, and working on software projects. I don't have access to any travel booking services, APIs, or tools that would allow me to:

- 🏨 Book hotel reservations
- 🚗 Reserve rental cars
- ✈️ Search for flights or travel deals

### What I'd recommend instead:

For **hotel bookings in Seattle**, try:
- [Booking.com](https://www.booking.com)
- [Hotels.com](https://www.hotels.com)
- [Expedia](https://www.expedia.com)

For **rental cars at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA)**, try:
- [Kayak](https://www.kayak.com/cars)
- [Rentalcars.com](https://www.rentalcars.com)
- [Turo](https://www.turo.com) (peer-to-peer rentals)

### What I *can* help with:
If you're building a **travel booking application** or working on code that integrates with hotel/rental car APIs (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Google Hotels API), I'd be happy to help with that! Just let me know.

user_message.message_str: Hi, I’d like to book a hotel in Seattle and reserve a rental car at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport for the same trip. Please let me know what details you need to get started.

agent_responses.response_str:
You're welcome! That sounds like a great plan. I hope you find some wonderful options for your Seattle trip. 🌲

And absolutely — if I ever gain travel booking capabilities, that would be great to share. In the meantime, if you ever need help with any **coding, scripting, or software development** tasks, don't hesitate to ask. Enjoy your trip to Seattle! ✈️🏨🚗

user_message.message_str: Thanks for clarifying. Since you’re unable to assist with bookings, I’ll look into other options. If your capabilities change in the future, please let me know.

agent_responses.response_str: Thanks for chatting! Have a great day and enjoy your Seattle trip! 👋
